name: scanpath-studio
summary: Interactive visualization of eye-tracking data from reading studies: draw, replay and compare scanpaths, fixations, saccades and gaze heatmaps over the text, and export figures and tables.
author: Maya Grossman, Keren Gruteke Klein, Deborah N. Jakobi, Ella Lion, Carlson Büth, David R. Reich, Lena Jäger, Yevgeni Berzak
